Source rows | What the workbook says | Where it appears in the app

text:
Source rows | What the workbook says | Where it appears in the app
Row 2 | Employer shoulders the tax so the employee receives a guaranteed net | Employer-absorbed share, default 100%
Row 3 | Divide the intended net by (1 − rate) | Available as the flat / final tax method

Rows 16–18 | Show gross, employer-absorbed tax, and net released | The four result tiles
